title: True Lord And Master Has Come
summary: Anger is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Meeting with the humble beings, O Siblings of Destiny, the Messenger of Death is conquered; the True Lord and Master has come to dwell within my mind
lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
